versions.changelog:
- Initial release of agentic_cli_coding.
- Provides the oce command: a safe, transaction-capable code editing toolkit supporting major languages.
- Enables reading, searching, editing, refactoring, and multi-file changes across codebases.
- Automatically validates syntax after edits and rolls back on failure.
- Includes workflows for discovery, reading, editing, verification, and recovery.
- Designed to safely replace raw sed/awk/perl-i for persistent codebase edits.
